requirements.text: The EVE supervisory outlier test applies the six scenarios: parallel up, parallel down, steepener, flattener, short rates up and short rates down.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024). The EVE outlier threshold (decline of more than 15 % of Tier 1) is set in CRD Art. 98(5), first point, not in this RTS.

requirements.text: The NII supervisory outlier test applies the parallel shock up and parallel shock down scenarios.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: Shock sizes are taken from Annex Part A per currency (EUR: parallel 200 bp, short 250 bp, long 100 bp) or calibrated per Annex Part B for other currencies, recalibrated at least every five years.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024). EUR values checked in Annex Part A.

requirements.text: Shocks are applied separately per currency with accounting value of 5 % or more of non-trading book financial assets or liabilities, or smaller currencies until 90 % of such assets (excluding tangible assets) or liabilities are covered.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: Key behavioural assumptions (including NMDs, prepayments and early redemptions) are adjusted to each shock scenario, applying the materiality thresholds of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/857 Art. 8(10), 9(2), 10(4), 12(2) and 23(1).
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024). The adopted RTS contains no separate NMD repricing cap; the 5-year cap is in EBA/GL/2022/14 para 111 (IMS) and core-maturity caps in 2024/857 Art. 8(9). Confirm which cap the bank applies in SOT.

requirements.text: Institutions with a non-performing exposures ratio of 2 % or more include NPEs, net of provisions, as interest rate sensitive instruments reflecting expected cash flows and their timing.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: Where commercial margins are excluded from EVE cash flows, the risk-free rate at inception is identified transparently, applied consistently, aligned with hedging practice and the exclusion is notified to the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: The change in EVE is computed on a run-off balance sheet.
requirements.quote: computed with the assumption of a run-off balance sheet, where existing positions mature and are not replaced
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: A post-shock rate floor is applied per currency, starting at -150 bp for immediate maturity and rising by 3 bp per year to 0 % at 50 years; lower observed rates are used where applicable.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: Per scenario, currency results are aggregated with positive changes weighted by 50 % (80 % for ERM II currencies with a narrower band), converted at the ECB spot rate on the reference date.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: Cash flows are discounted with a general risk-free yield curve per currency excluding instrument-, sector- or entity-specific credit and liquidity spreads.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: The NII test covers interest income and expenses over a one-year horizon regardless of the maturity and accounting treatment of the instruments.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024). Commercial margins must be included in NII per Art. 4(3) (not split out to stay within 14 requirements).

requirements.text: The change in NII is computed on a constant balance sheet, replacing maturing or repricing instruments with instruments of comparable currency, amount and repricing period, priced at recent (not historical) margins.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).

requirements.text: The NII outlier test flags a large decline where one-year NII falls by more than 5 % of Tier 1 capital under either parallel scenario.
requirements.quote: a decline of an institution’s one-year net interest income by more than 5 % of its Tier 1 capital
requirements.verification_note: Checked against the OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/856 (OJ L, 24.4.2024).
